_comment: Production config — committed to the repo on purpose so any relay install (this server, a backup server, a fresh box) ends up with the same tokens, and customer-side agent.exe binaries keep working. Tokens here are the source of truth for prod. Edit + commit + redeploy to rotate.
_security_note: This file contains real credentials. The repo MUST stay private. To rotate tokens: edit this file -> commit -> on each server: sudo rm /opt/remote-desktop-relay/config.json && sudo bash deploy/install.sh.
